Package com.smartlostfound.model

Class Item

java.lang.Object
com.smartlostfound.model.Item
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
FoundItem, LostItem
public abstract class Item extends Object implements Serializable
Base domain model for items tracked in the Smart Lost & Found system. Encapsulates common attributes and defines contracts for lost and found items.
